title: An excellent tour - well worth listening to the detailed history.
text: Super tour. Our tour guide, Jesus was extremely knowledgeable and provided very comprehensive information throughout. He injected a little humour when appropriate  and captured everyone's interest. Excellent. The Cathedral and its history is very impressive, including  fascinating information about the building itself, paintings, the gold and silver adornments therein and the coffin of Christopher Columbus.
author: christopherd558

title: wonder
text: The Cathedral must definitely be seen because you are dazzled by its beauty and magnificence. It is simply enormous and very rich. Definitely buy the ticket in advance to skip the line and then climb the Giralda tower from which you can see the city from above and from four sides. There are no steps but ramps. It is worth the effort. It is well worth a walk in the dark to see it illuminated.

title: Amazing views - inside the cathedral and from the rooftop!
text:
Eu25 per person - rooftop tour (including entry to main cathedral and giralda tower). 
Separate side entry door, small queue, prompt entry. Quick hand out of tour headphones.. and you're off. Spanish guide with great English. The rooftop tour gets you to some amazing locations only accessible through the tour. All the walkways overlooking the main cathedral space, the highest stained-glass windows, and the roof itself. Do not forget your camera/phone - the views are incredible - inside of the cathedral and out, from the roof. The guide has a lot of insights and interesting facts.
Lasts about a
